 Performs highly visible on\-site and remote software installations and upgrades of all Varian Software products, which includes troubleshooting and diagnosis as needed. Executes the installation of a technical discipline at the installation site.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Works with physical and virtual environments, operating systems, databases and other software and networking technologies.
* Reviews scope of work for assigned tasks to ensure all hardware and software components are available.
* Reviews customer IT infrastructure and project plans to ensure they meet documented installation requirements.
* Completes all necessary task documentation to meet Varian's Quality processes and procedures.
* Maintains customer system inventories using Site Equipment Configuration documentation or equivalent.
* Keeps current on Varian products and technologies through both internal and external training and certification.
* Creates and maintains an account with VCS (Vendor Credentialing System).
* Teams with project management, local service and hardware installation teams to provide World Class Customer Service.
* Requires limited direct supervision.
* Performs upgrades and new installations as well as team leader duties on small to medium scale software projects.
* Input detailed records of installation and upgrade work performed into company information systems to ensure accurate updated customer installation information is available to other VMS functions.
* Maintain a high degree of professionalism and safety according to VMS guidelines and customer regulations in order to perform activities under the safest working conditions.
* Report by means of FSR's, time sheets, expense reports, etc. regularly and in a timely fashion to ensure that accurate company statistical data on customer\-oriented activities is available.
* Complete all required installation documentation that pertains to the job being completed and update all requested and/or required data for tracking purposes as per the applicable Varian's Quality processes and procedures.
* Use prescribed problem\-resolution escalation procedures and request technical assistance when necessary in a timely manner.
* Attend planning calls and provide technical input as needed. Advise customers on where to find Customer Technical Bulletins, Release Notes and related product information and why these documents are important.
* Use prescribed problem\-resolution escalation procedures and request technical assistance when necessary, in a timely manner.
* Advise less experienced Installation Representatives in technical matters.
* Proficient computer usage and debugging skills Knowledge of and sound professional experience with Microsoft based server operating systems
* Customer focused attitude Articulate and skilled in interpersonal communication
* Fluency in the local language and in English, both written and spoken
* Comprehensive knowledge of networks and networking techniques
* Functional knowledge of Citrix and VMWare technologies
* Familiar with business tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel, SharePoint and time reporting systems.
* Associate's Degree or equivalent experience 1\-3 years of directly related and transferrable experience
